# Anne Shirley & Cornelia Bryant

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) — visiting neighbor and friend · since v4  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P75](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0075), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P76](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0076), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P15](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0015), +10 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) reflect on their perfect honeymoon month at [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor) and Gilbert's recent medical success. Later, Miss Cornelia [Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) visits them to sew clothes for a needy family while sharing her outspoken opinions on marriage, religion, and the local townspeople.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL

> Miss Cornelia shares her sharp opinions on men, the local minister, and mutual acquaintances while visiting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Before concluding her visit, Miss Cornelia agrees to stay for tea and reveals she knows [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has been listening and laughing from his office.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL

> Miss Cornelia visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and recounts the tragic life history of [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), including her family misfortunes, forced marriage, and caring for her brain-damaged husband [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md).
>

> Miss Cornelia encourages [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to be a persistent friend to [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) despite her reserved nature and difficult domestic life with [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md). Touched by Leslie's tragic situation, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolves to do everything she can to win Leslie's friendship.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P39](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0039), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P41](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0041), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P42](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0042)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) host their first [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) dinner at their home in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), welcoming guests including [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), Captain Jim, and Miss Cornelia. While dinner is prepared and served, Captain Jim and Miss Cornelia engage in a lively debate to Gilbert's amusement. After a successful meal carved by [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), the party gathers by the hearth as Captain Jim shares stories before taking his leave.
>

> Captain Jim visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to bring her quahog shells for her garden and sweet-grass, sharing memories and thoughts on nature. Later, Captain Jim, Miss Cornelia, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Susan](../character/susan.md) gather at the house to discuss local news, religion, and neighbors, which ends in Captain Jim and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) stepping outside to laugh at the women's commentary.
>

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P6](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P15](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P21](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P57](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0057)_

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) stays with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as she gives birth to a newborn girl named Joyce, but the baby tragically passes away later that evening. Friends and family offer comfort and prepare the baby for burial, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) grieves deeply and struggles to find meaning or comfort in her sorrow.
>

Later, Captain Jim and Miss Cornelia visit, chatting over pie about neighborhood news, including [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) agreeing to take in a summer boarder named [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md).
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P0](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P2](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P11](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P24](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0024)_

> [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) drops off [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) at Anne's house so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can guide him to Leslie's, where he will be boarding. While walking him over, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Owen chat about the area's history and his hopes of finding inspiration for a novel. Upon arriving, Owen is struck by Leslie's beauty and meets the Moore household.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P1](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P17](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P24](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0024)_

> In the garden, [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he is deeply in love with [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) and agonizes over having to leave her behind in her miserable life. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) sympathizes with his grief while agreeing that he must go away silently. Miss Cornelia interrupts their quiet moment with a blunt remark, lightening the tense mood before Owen leaves.
>

> Miss Cornelia visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to chat about newspaper obituaries, past town memories, and Leslie's feelings for [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), joined briefly by [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Later, [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) grieves over the death of her old dog [Carlo](../character/carlo.md) to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). After returning from a New Year's visit to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are welcomed home by Captain Jim and Miss Cornelia, who shares news about Owen Ford's book.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P0](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P12](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P26](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0026), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P30](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0030)_

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) consult Captain Jim, who surprisingly agrees that [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) must be informed about the medical possibility for [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md). [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tells [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), who decides to take [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md) to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for the operation despite the emotional toll. Later, Miss Cornelia angrily confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) over the decision, but eventually accepts that nothing can stop the plan.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P4](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P22](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0022), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P30](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P48](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0048)_

> [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) prepares for Dick's surgery in [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) with Gilbert's assistance, securing financial help through a mortgage from Captain Jim. Later, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) returns home to find [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in shock over a letter from [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). The letter reveals that the man believed to be [Dick Moore](../character/dick-moore.md) is actually his lookalike cousin, [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md), and that [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md) died years ago.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P1](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P5](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P16](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028)_

> Miss Cornelia visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), utterly shocked by the news that the man believed to be [Dick Moore](../character/dick-moore.md) is actually his cousin [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md), freeing [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) from her marriage. They discuss how George and [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md) looked so much alike, how everyone was deceived, and Miss Cornelia urges [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to let [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) know about Leslie's freedom.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gives birth to a healthy baby boy, whom she and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) name James Matthew after Captain Jim and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), Captain Jim, and Miss Cornelia visit to admire the child and celebrate his arrival. Later, Miss Cornelia tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) plans to return for a visit, and they discuss Leslie's future plans.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR

> In the wake of the general election, Captain Jim visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) to share news of the [Liberal](../codex/factions.md#liberal) victory. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits the lighthouse, where she encounters a newly clean-shaven [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall-elliott.md). She then spends quiet moments with Captain Jim, who reflects on aging and his mortality, making [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) promise to care for his cat, [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md).
>

[Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) arrives to visit [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to encourage [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) to embrace her feelings and the future ahead of her.

She discusses her wedding plans, including her decision against wearing a veil with her navy blue dress, and traded light banter with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) about managing a husband.

> On a spring evening at [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md) sit on the veranda with sleeping children [Rilla](../character/rilla-blythe.md) and [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) while awaiting a visit from [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) chat about being back home after three months in [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe), enjoying local gossip and reflecting on neighbors' lives as [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) approaches.

Afterward, Miss Cornelia, [Susan](../character/susan.md), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discuss Mary's mischievous antics and potential matches for the local minister.

Encouraged by [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) boldly visits [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) to ask if she will adopt Mary. > After [Dan Reese](../character/dan-reese.md) insults [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md) confronts him and agrees to a fight the next evening. Despite his dread, Walter wins the battle after school, defending [Faith](../character/faith.md) and his mother. On his way home through [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), he meets Mr. Meredith, who approves of his fighting for a good cause, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later comforts him after hearing what happened.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY

> Walter reports his courage to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who comforts him after his fight. Downstairs, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Miss Cornelia, and [Susan](../character/susan.md) discuss Walter's fight and gossip about Mr. Meredith's potential romance with [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md).

> [Faith](../character/faith.md) causes a scandal in [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary by attending church without stockings, sparking community gossip and concern among [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md) and Miss Cornelia. In [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), the other children discuss the incident, and Jerry punishes [Faith](../character/faith.md) via the [Good-Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#good-conduct-club) by making her wear her hated striped stockings. To clear her father of any blame, [Faith](../character/faith.md) writes a detailed letter of explanation to the local newspaper.
>

> Cornelia Elliott discusses the minister's children and their graveyard performance with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Prompted by Cornelia's feedback, Mr. Meredith confronts his children about singing in the churchyard during the prayer meeting. After addressing their thoughtlessness gently, Mr. Meredith mourns his parenting abilities and longs for [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md).
>

> Jerry decrees punishments for his siblings' cowardice, ordering [Carl](../character/carl.md) to sit alone in the graveyard until midnight. [Carl](../character/carl.md) bravely completes the ordeal in a chilling rainstorm, but comes down with severe pneumonia as a result. After fighting through a dangerous crisis with Dr. Blythe's care, [Carl](../character/carl.md) recovers and is welcomed back by his friends and family.
>

> In the evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Miss Cornelia, and [Susan](../character/susan.md) discuss the upcoming double wedding and the arrangements for the children while the newlyweds are away. Meanwhile, in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), the children gather on Jem's last evening before he leaves for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), where Walter and [Jem](../character/jem.md) speak of battles and following the Pied Piper's call into the future.
